feedback: I accuse Elle. The physical bottle was present on an open support, and the supplied slides contained only stitches. Her final claim that production projected the bottle while the real loan stayed in the cupboard directly contradicts independent records. This matters to murder because it denies exposure to the poison source; she also admits carrying fabric beside the unattended glass. The split closure, matching type of paper in the glass, active bottle residue, and individually poisoned toast support a transfer from bottle to glass, though they do not identify a hand by themselves. Hugh also falsely says the press printed the original-contents condition, but concealing a troublesome sale explains that lie without requiring murder. Penny falsely calls her family valuation comparable; that points to financial deception. Chip admits altering the insurance date and missing the rear split, leaving serious suspicion but no uniquely incriminating paper match. Barb deliberately removed recording, and Brie added flavoring, yet their accounts are independently supported; the clean retained ingredient weakens the simplest catering theory. The voices feel human, especially their embarrassment and practical concerns, although the repeated question groups and documentary rebuttals feel engineered. No innocent account seems intrinsically unfair, but the timing of the bottle theft and individual room visits remains loose.
fairness_gaps: No document establishes when the bottle was emptied or independently places Elle handling it; the accusation depends substantially on her false account and admitted glass-side opportunity.
A clean retained flavoring container cannot absolutely exclude a separately contaminated dose or later addition; it weakens suspicion of Brie without eliminating her.
The treatment-date alteration is acknowledged but its insurance significance is unexplained, leaving Chip with an unresolved lie adjacent to the poison source.
